metadata.name: Boss Rewards Mod
metadata.description:
Grants a random reward every time you clear a boss, miniboss, or Boss Rush room in The Binding of Isaac: Repentance.
Features:
Random reward after clearing Boss, Miniboss, and Boss Rush rooms (one reward per wave cleared in Boss Rush).
Two possible reward types: extra health (red, soul, or black heart) or a permanent stat boost (damage, tears, speed, luck, range, or shot speed).
Extra chance for an Angel Room to appear when entering a boss room, applied before the fight begins.
Local co-op compatible.
